A command already watched, a command that cannot write files, a non-git project or the absence of any older tree all mean no watch at all. The chosen "before" is always older than the command, so a diff from it can only hold more than the command wrote, never less; what an earlier tool of the turn already reported is subtracted when the row settles. requirements.windows_path: ShellCommandKind.mayWriteFiles decides writability from the command title; port_impacts.md entry 88 fixes its table at 52 readers, 25 and 15, with anything not in readers making the whole command a writer and a chain with one writing part writing. Everything else in the table is reproduced verbatim.
requirements.verification_method: integration test against a real repository

deviation.upstream: Shell.swift:162 searchActions lacks -fprint, -fprint0, -fprintf, -fls, --exec and --exec-batch; :200-201 sort counts as a reader unless an argument hasPrefix("-o"), so --output= reads; :154-159 gitReaders holds config, tag and remote, so git config user.email x, git tag v1 and git remote add origin url read, and such commands are never watched.
deviation.port: Those commands count as writing (the exact write actions are ED-060's), so watchCommand watches them; every other entry of the table is unchanged.

A call that passes the gates is given a fresh parser whenever it is not a delta or the held parser names another entry or turn; otherwise the held parser is reused. So when two assistant rows deliver deltas before any stream exists, the second row's delta starts a fresh parser, and a return to the first row reads only its newest delta (from reading the code; not run). endDelegationStream() sets both hydraStream and delegationParser to nil and is called by startTurn, by install when no turn is current, and by both branches of dropDelegationBlock. The streamed branch of spawnDelegatedHeads sets hydraStream = nil directly and leaves delegationParser in place until the next startTurn.
requirements.windows_path: The parser type is specified by PR-HYDRA-095; this requirement is its lifecycle in the runtime.
requirements.verification_method: unit - deltas of one row across three flushes feed one parser; a non-delta call, or a delta for another row while no stream is pinned, starts a fresh one; a call for another row while a stream is pinned to the first leaves the parser in place; startTurn, idle install and dropDelegationBlock clear it
